question: Do either count-qualified phase-modular oil sensors own a naturally frequent, after-cost, directionally and temporally stable one-position lifecycle?

windows.validation_law: unopened unless one frozen profile passes every discovery gate; selected discovery profile only

rejected_control: physical_phase_clocks is permanently count-rejected above 767 entries/year and cannot enter economics

lifecycle.entry: next matched-MCL minute open after completed phase-local CL turn, same-sign completed MCL parity, and resolved continuous macro state
lifecycle.acceptance: phase-local turn agrees with continuous macro state
lifecycle.failure: phase-local turn opposes continuous macro state
lifecycle.same_direction: hold without re-entry or branch relabel
lifecycle.opposite_direction: close and flip at the same next MCL open
lifecycle.contract_roll: close old matched MCL at its final common close and remain flat until a fresh post-roll event

discovery_and_validation_gates.directions: up and down each >=20 and stress-positive
discovery_and_validation_gates.branches: acceptance and failure each >=20 and stress-positive
discovery_and_validation_gates.physical_phases: Asia, Europe, and US each >=20 and stress-positive
discovery_and_validation_gates.lanes: GTH and RTH each >=30 and stress-positive
discovery_and_validation_gates.temporal: >=8 stress-positive months and >=3 of four stress-positive equal-duration quarters per year
discovery_and_validation_gates.density: median 1-3, p95 <=6, maximum <=10 trades per active session

selection_law: Only profiles passing every discovery gate compete; select maximum stress PnL/DD, then stress PF, then stress net. If neither passes, validation remains sealed. If one passes, only its validation may open and must repeat every gate unchanged.
full_law: Only independently passing discovery and validation ledgers may combine; require the same economic/cohort/density gates plus >=16 stress-positive months and >=6 of eight stress-positive equal-duration quarters. Missing July-2023-August-2024 still blocks a crown.
prohibitions: no phase, horizon, state, retrace, parity, macro, branch, time, or profile change after this freeze
no stop, target, timeout, profit memory, sizing, quota, news, companion, or outcome rescue
no production refactor, order, or capital authority
